versions.changelog:
AlphaGBM Duan Yongping Analysis skill v1.0.0 – new release.

- Provides concise, Duan-style seller playbook for any ticker: Sell Put, Covered Call, and Panic-Buy context all in one response.
- Each panel tightly scoped to Duan Yongping’s renowned seller-only, “rent-collection” options logic.
- Triggers off natural user queries for “Duan Yongping style” or rent-collection setups.
- Precise API: `/api/options/duan-analysis` with required ticker and optional buy_price.
- Outputs actionable data cards for sell put, covered call, and VIX “panic buy” context.
